acceptanceCriteria: A fresh dogfood-change / dogfood-check / dogfood-seal round trip in a plain clone binds, checks and seals a cem/1.0 map; the CEM-V1-032 refusal and the canonical-only batch admission are removed with their spec text amended in the same change.
cem prepare, begin, cover, discriminate and structural mark write cem/1.0 and OCM prepare admits it; each has a positive stable case and a refusal control.
docs/DOGFOOD.md and the affected specs describe the cem/1.0 producer; NOT_PRODUCED reasons stay visible.
body: Source: decision 0525 (docs/decisions/0525-cem-1-0-only-rc3-2026-10-11.md, PR beamfall/corvint#819), owner instruction 2026-10-11 that rc.3 ships cem/1.0 as the only CEM. Owner lane: orchestrating session; the CEM 1.0 vision session owns the wire (V1-1262/1273/1263/1264/1265/1266). Cut the dogfood loop over to cem/1.0: `make dogfood-change/check/seal` and `corvint cem prepare/begin/cover/discriminate/mark` produce cem/1.0, the CEM-V1-032 refusals in internal/dogfoodflow/change.go and the wire.Canonical-only batch admission in internal/dogfoodflow/batch.go are lifted, and OCM prepare (internal/lrfrepo/ocm_write.go) accepts cem/1.0. Adopts the decision 0523 P3 reasoned unknown hunks (V1-1258). V1-1266's next-30-dogfood-changes criterion depends on this ticket. Parts that do not depend on the frozen V1-1265 shape may land before it.
title: cem/1.0 decision 0525 step 5: dogfood producer writes cem/1.0 (lift CEM-V1-032 refusal, adopt P3 reasoned unknown hunks)
